lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are organized into a series of vertical columns on the mid-lateral flank, with approximately 5-7 spots per column arranged in a quasi-rectangular grid.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a checkerboard-like grid where the blobs act as anchor nodes at the intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges (carinae) are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp transition from high-luminance pixels on the dorsal side to a distinct shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The macro-mask of the first dorsal fin contains approximately 12-15 small, high-luminance blobs distributed across its lateral surface, with higher density observed near the leading edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a large white remora attached to the ventral surface near the pectoral fin base and two small yellow fish swimming in close proximity to the ventral midline.
